title: Audit: visitorId vs email mismatch in queries
description: Use critique-waves to find places where code assumes visitorId equals email, or uses wrong identifier for lookups.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Create instructions.md with FORBIDDEN/REQUIRED patterns for ID usage
Create tracker.md with goal of 6 consecutive passes
Run waves of 3 parallel agents checking: (1) convex/ queries, (2) src/ useVisitorId usage, (3) leaderboard ID handling
Continue until 6 consecutive passes or issues found

notes: CODE REVIEW ONLY - NO BROWSER. FORBIDDEN: using user.email as visitorId, querying by email field with visitorId value, querying by visitorId field with email value. REQUIRED: consistent ID type per query. Known bug: leaderboard.ts line 101, 150 uses email as visitorId.
